card.name: The word be after should or need not
card.fires_on: The word "be" (or "been") right after "should", "need not" or "should have" in label instructions. It comes just before a verb like discontinued, interrupted, stopped or skipped.

modes.description: "be" after "should" or "need not" where the next word will be discontinued, interrupted, stopped or skipped.
